description: Read a weekly payer follow-up with the account ID and the access token returned when it was started: whether payment is settled, each application's status (not_checked, received, in_review, needs_documents, approved with its effective date, denied, no_record, or no_decision when the checks stopped without a decision, with the date it can be reopened until), whether we write and submit it (work: write_and_submit, with submitted_on empty until it is submitted) or it was already submitted (work: follow_up), what we still need from you before we submit one we write (waiting_on_you), the payer's reference or representative, missing documents, the last and next check, check_every_days, and the log of every check (date, method, who checked, what the payer said, and how many reads found the same answer); what is happening on each one right now (now_doing: one line read from the records our checks leave, such as on hold with the payer's line, asked by email and waiting for the reply, or the payer's status page read, with that record's time and live true while it happens); each message sent to the payer about it (receipts: a status email, an automated call or the written application, each with sent, arrived and answered); another open application for the same clinician, payer and state, one that may have been started twice (overlaps); for one we write, where its submission stands (submission: step, channel email, fax, mail or web, and clinician_to_do when the clinician must sign or submit in the payer's own system); the roster's changes from weekly monitoring; the deadlines within 30 and 90 days; for an application bundle, the steps only a clinician can do for the applications we write (clinician_tasks: each step, its status upcoming, to_do, said_done or done, its deadline, the applications it is for, and contact_needed when we cannot reach the clinician); and the status webhook (webhook: its url and updated_at, or null; never its secret).

access_token.description: The access_token payer_follow_up_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed status link.

name: payer_follow_up_status
title: Read a weekly payer follow-up
